title: Head of Engineering
description:
Job Description – Head of Engineering

**Company:** Distinct Infotech Solutions  
**Job Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 12–18+ Years  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

**1. About the Role**

Distinct Infotech Solutions is looking for an experienced **Head of Engineering** to lead its engineering function, drive technology strategy, and oversee the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise software solutions.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with engineering leadership capabilities, ensuring scalable and secure application architecture, efficient development processes, high-quality delivery, and continuous innovation.

The role requires someone capable of leading engineering teams, managing technical roadmaps, making critical architectural decisions, mentoring technical leaders, and aligning technology initiatives with business objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Engineering Leadership & Management

* Lead and manage the overall engineering and software development function.
* Define engineering strategies, technical roadmaps, and development priorities aligned with business goals.
* Build, mentor, and manage engineering teams, including Technical Managers, Tech Leads, Architects, and Developers.
* Establish engineering standards, coding practices, development methodologies, and quality benchmarks.
* Drive team productivity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Identify resource requirements, allocate technical resources, and support recruitment and team development.
* Conduct technical performance reviews and support career development of engineering team members.

B. Solution Architecture & Technical Strategy

* Design and govern end-to-end architecture for scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications.
* Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and architectural designs.
* Define application, integration, infrastructure, and deployment architectures.
* Lead architectural decisions involving Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and distributed systems.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and tools and conduct Proof of Concepts (POCs).
* Ensure architectural consistency, reusability, scalability, and maintainability across projects.

C. Software Development & Delivery Management

* Oversee the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and planning to deployment and maintenance.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining quality and technical standards.
* Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and technical teams.
* Monitor development progress, identify delivery bottlenecks, and implement corrective measures.
* Establish Agile/Scrum practices and improve development efficiency.
* Oversee code reviews, testing strategies, deployment processes, and production support.

D. Technology & Cloud Infrastructure

* Drive cloud architecture and infrastructure strategy across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Guide containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Ensure system scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.
* Define database architecture and integration strategies across SQL and NoSQL platforms.

E. Technical Governance & Security

* Establish technical governance frameworks and enforce engineering best practices.
* Ensure compliance with application security standards and organizational policies.
* Oversee authentication, authorization, API security, and secure coding practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical risk assessments, and performance evaluations.
* Identify and reduce technical debt while improving system reliability and maintainability.

F. Innovation & Emerging Technologies

* Drive technology innovation and evaluate new tools, platforms, and development approaches.
* Explore AI-powered applications, automation, LLM integrations, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Encourage adoption of modern engineering practices and technology-driven solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes through technology.

G. Stakeholder & Business Collaboration

* Work closely with senior management and business stakeholders to align engineering initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Participate in client discussions, technical presentations, solution proposals, and architecture reviews.
* Support technical estimations, project feasibility assessments, and resource planning.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to management.

H. Technical Documentation

* Ensure the preparation and maintenance of Architecture Design Documents (ADD), Technical Design Documents (TDD), API specifications, infrastructure diagrams, deployment documentation, and engineering standards.

**3. Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Enterprise Software Architecture and Application Design.
* Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Distributed Systems.
* Strong programming background in .NET / ASP.NET Core, C#, Java, Node.js, or Python.
* REST API design, API Gateway, system integration, and performance optimization.
* Cloud architecture experience in Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code.
* SQL and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ and Kafka.
* Security practices including OAuth, JWT, SSO, and secure coding standards.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications, LLMs, AI agents, and automation is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Design Patterns, SOLID Principles, and software engineering best practices.

**4. Leadership & Management Competencies**

* Proven experience leading large or cross-functional engineering teams.
* Ability to define and execute technology and engineering strategies.
* Strong decision-making, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Experience managing multiple projects, teams, and technical priorities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to mentor senior technical professionals and build high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of engineering operations, delivery management, and resource planning.

**5. Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree is an added advantage.
* 12–18+ years of overall software development and engineering experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Architecture, or Engineering Leadership roles.
* Proven experience leading engineering teams and managing enterprise software development.
* Experience designing and implementing large-scale, cloud-based applications.
* Strong experience in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Previous experience managing technical teams, engineering delivery, and architectural governance.

6. Preferred Certifications

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.
* Google Professional Cloud Architect.
* TOGAF Certification.
* Kubernetes Certification (CKA / CKAD).
* Scrum Certification (CSM / PSM).

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Overall engineering productivity and team performance.
* Successful and timely delivery of software projects.
* Quality, scalability, security, and reliability of solution architecture.
* Improvement in development efficiency and engineering processes.
* Reduction in technical debt and production issues.
* Effective resource utilization and engineering team development.
* Adoption of modern technologies, automation, and reusable solutions.
* Compliance with technical standards and security requirements.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and alignment of engineering initiatives with business goals.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Solution Architecture or Enterprise Architecture?
* Do you have experience in AI application development?
* How many years of experience do you have with Microservices Architecture?
* How many enterprise-scale projects have you led?
* How many years of experience in software development and engineering?
* Are you an immediate joiner?

Experience:

* .NET Core: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Manager – Business Analysis \- ACS Song**

**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**

**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**

**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification**: **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.


  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* 10\-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of complex client\-facing digital commerce, CPQ or pricing engagements
* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Ability to lead product owners, Business Analysts, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive\-level verbal and written communication for proposals, client presentations, solution pitches, demos, decisions and programme reporting.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Strong working knowledge of CPQ capabilities including product and bundle configuration, guided selling, quote creation, pricing, approvals, contracts and quote\-to\-cash touchpoints.
* Strong working knowledge of pricing capabilities including price strategy, segmentation, price books/lists, discounts, promotions, taxation, regional pricing, optimisation and price\-engine integrations.
* Experience with one or more relevant platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Revenue Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, PROS, Conga or similar is considered a plus.
* Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.
* Relevant certification such as PSPO, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master, commerce platform, CPQ or pricing certification is preferred.
* Pricing domain knowledge including price books, price lists, promotions, discounts, taxation, regional pricing and price engine integrations.
* Working knowledge of delivery automation, version control, deployment strategies and DevOps collaboration sufficient to govern cross\-functional delivery.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
* Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event\-driven integrations or cloud\-native delivery.
* Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration.
